title: prisma migrate dev
description: Create, iterate, customize, and apply development migrations using the Prisma CLI.

data.text: `prisma migrate dev` is the development command that automates the migration loop during feature implementation. It detects changes made in `schema.prisma`, creates a new timestamped migration directory containing a `migration.sql` file, executes that SQL on your development database, and regenerates Prisma Client.

data.title: Running migrate dev
data.content: Always provide a descriptive name for your migration.
data.code:
# Create and apply a new migration
npx prisma migrate dev --name add_user_avatar

# Create migration without applying immediately (allows manual SQL editing)
npx prisma migrate dev --create-only --name add_gin_trgm_index

# Skip client generation if desired
npx prisma migrate dev --skip-generate

data.text: Sometimes you need advanced PostgreSQL features that Prisma schema syntax doesn't directly express (e.g. creating extensions like `pg_trgm`, defining database triggers, or adding specialized check constraints). Using `--create-only` creates the SQL file so you can append custom SQL before applying it.

data.title: prisma/migrations/20240101_add_trgm/migration.sql
data.content: Adding custom PostgreSQL extensions and indexes.

data.title: Commit Migration Files to Git
data.text: All files generated under `prisma/migrations/` MUST be committed to Git. They are the authoritative ledger of your database schema history.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: `prisma migrate dev` is intended strictly for local development.
Use `--create-only` to write custom SQL statements like extensions and triggers.
Always commit the `prisma/migrations` folder to version control.
